lineage.reuse_identity_policy: Immutable AO source and full pass required. No controller, production or optimizer activation.

sources.constructor: Reuse exact F124-AO first-admitted paired graph birth with NEW source cohorts and NEW frozen disjoint affine/Feistel operator identities. Preserve 24 public examples and exactly three corrupted output-bit observations; original source-only graph inverse unchanged.
sources.truth: Only evaluator sees operator inverse, class, ground truth and authentic pair status; public demos symmetric between positive and negative, old literal shortcut invalid.
sources.split_contract: TRAIN solely for selection. DEV sources constructed once AFTER successful qualified TRAIN artifact, immutable parameter freeze and preflight qualification, no DEV retries/retuning if first run fails.

Yggdrasil.hypothesis: A learned non-catalog dual-space relational representation over public support input-output pairs with kernels can recover unfamiliar inverse mappings more effectively than per-bit example trees and nearest-neighbor or the affine-only model.
Yggdrasil.inverse_representation: Use 16 observed transformed output bits as continuous +/-1 latent features; learn a regularized inverse to 16 source bits from 20 public examples using 20x20 Gram linear system with 16 continuous targets; threshold predictions to bits. No source operator grammar or family.
Yggdrasil.selection: On fresh TRAIN paired labels choose among 16 fixed candidates: prioritize zero FP if possible, maximize paired accuracy, then fewest FN, lower measured model bit/float ops and lexicographic tie-break. Do not consult true inverse or operator class for selection.
Yggdrasil.task_model_memory: All per-task support arrays/Gram coefficients and transient solver work explicitly counted separately as additional inference working storage; may NOT be represented as just 16 cells. No changes to original 7+9 cognition.
Yggdrasil.DEV_criteria: Strict positive sensitivity and zero false positives on all 48, exceed strongest eligible original learned control; characterize unfamiliar affine and Feistel performance by family and compare to evaluator ceiling. If not, preserve authentic negative.
Yggdrasil.limitations: These are supervision-based small-kernel function learners, not a claim of autonomous neural general cognition or unlimited operator generality.

Wingless.hypothesis: Unlike terminal-margin and sibling-only penalties, evidence that is inconsistent at multiple intermediate handoffs can be selectively penalized within the same cumulative score while preserving one 12-bit packed state per node.
Wingless.selection: On source-normalized TRAIN graphs select among original control and six nonzero configurations, first require retaining EACH original gamma0 accepted long positive. Then maximum pair correct, minimum FP, minimum extra work, deterministic preference baseline.
Wingless.DEV_criteria: Keep each and every original gamma0 13-15-hop positive; strictly fewer FP than gamma0, same graph input, exact original max 64 nodes and 12 bits one state per node. No substitute weak-domain comparators.
Wingless.interpretation: Evaluator/source-normalized conditional scorer only, NOT learned operation identification; record model-only runtime, Python peak, transient graph indices and candidate work.

qualification.initial_work: Freeze source and candidate contracts in Git; implement candidate code, verify exact parent blob ancestry, Windows/Linux focused and isolation; authentic prior original receipt custody. Run TRAIN selection and save raw artifact SHA with zero DEV cases. DEV requires a second frozen selection commit and an independently checked source-only evaluator preflight.
qualification.final_after_DEV: One final complete Go test+race+vet+build+isolation regression; no multiple redundant system-level regressions.
